headline: Sensex and Nifty drop sharply amid high oil prices, persistent FII selling, and derivative swings

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: High crude oil prices weighing on domestic market sentiment
Persistent Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) selling mounting losses in September
Derivative market swings and expiry-day volatility jolting indices
Weak global cues and macroeconomic headwinds impacting investor confidence
whatHappening: BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty experienced sharp declines across recent trading sessions
Tata Chemicals dropped 4.5% amid broader market weakness
Allcargo Logistics announced the appointment of Vijay Nehra as MD & CEO
Government lowered foodgrain production target due to El Nino fears
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty have faced sharp declines triggered by high crude oil prices and sustained FII selling. Derivatives volatility and expiry-day swings further amplified market weakness in late September. Individual stock movements saw Tata Chemicals slip 4.5% while Allcargo Logistics announced a top leadership appointment.
